entries.name: Sequence Advantage
entries.text: If the diviner is 2+ Sequences stronger than the target, they ignore the target's passive Sequence penalty (but active techniques like Door Misdirection still apply at half penalty, rounded up).

entries.name: Direct Link
entries.text: Having the target's true name + an intimate personal item halves all anti-divination penalties (round down).

entries.name: HP Sacrifice
entries.text: Burning 4+ HP (at 2 HP = 1 SPI rate) when casting a divination ignores -2 of anti-divination penalties for that attempt.

entries.name: Anti-Anti-Divination Ritual
entries.text: A dedicated ritual (base difficulty -4, requires rare materials worth £100+) can temporarily suppress a target's protective techniques for 1d hours. This requires the target's name and a personal item.

entries.name: Divine Intervention
entries.text: A prayer to an orthodox deity whose domain includes divination (the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, the Evernight Goddess) may grant a temporary bypass — but the deity will expect something in return. The GM should set a clear cost (a future service, a sacrifice, or a quest) and may limit this to once per story arc.
